test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I entered my room / and switch on the lights / but it was / still dark.
solution:
The erroneous part is option 3) i.e. 'and switch on the lights.'
